question.problem:
What is the solution to the following system of inequalities?

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x+3<4 \\ 3-2x\le 9\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To solve the system, we need to find the values of $x$ that satisfy both $x+3<4$ and $3-2x\le 9$ simultaneously.

- First, we solve $x+3<4\,:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}x+3 & <4 \\ x+3-3 & <4-3 \\ x & <1\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14224662/assets/c20ffc0279a42a429797f42fcd929fb4dfb499e311dd3ed7b6b61fd95729953c.png)

$$

$$

- Then, we solve $3-2x\le 9\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}3-2x & \le 9 \\ 3-2x-3 & \le 9-3 \\ -2x & \le 6 \\ (-1)\cdot (-2x) & \ge (-1)\cdot 6 \\ 2x & \ge -6 \\ \frac{2x}{2} & \ge \frac{-6}{2} \\ x & \ge -3\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14224662/assets/ae72342a32ea8a952a3d00aec7a8ccc381804ae4b593ba58113911c4bc4b2c09.png)

To find the values of $x$ that satisfy both inequalities, we find where the two solutions overlap:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14224662/assets/b7d4814919a8c0b2a2ed8e130c8af2bdce5e7fd2d23d10e50e4e293d88170c2f.png)

 

$$

$$

Thus, the final solution is $x\in [-3,1).$
